traced.note: Moved the pin about 110 m north-west onto the one building in the station's meadow: a gray roof on the photo, and a square-cornered levelled block in the lidar relief (Oregon DOGAMI). No other building shows within 400 m. Not traced: the dirt track that runs north-west from the building doesn't show plainly to its end.
